name: # The suite of project mode, ie of a project stack's TRE, whose config names its smoke member (SMOKE_MEMBER): the tests that a member can run, as the smoke member, see
# SmokeUser, and the checks of the TRE and its identity that need no user.  It assumes what the member reads is there: the smoke member's credentials (manage-identity
# smoke-credentials), a grant on each Data Provider and its released and staging tables (spark-polaris-smoke and manage-data release on each Data Provider).
# tetragon and loki use the pod of the smoke member, signed in to the hub, which starts it, see UserPod.
# Not in it: spark-polaris, which skips a project's TRE, and git, which needs the user's Git credentials, which a member's are not known.
